revisionDesc.change: Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - Please note that at the relevant locations in the commentary to P.Mich. V 238 ed has indicated equivalent passages in P.Mich. II 124. So, these must be attributed to P.Mich. V 238, rather than to yourself. Note also that there are a number of minor differences between the two texts, or at least seem to be. So, please consider (1) re-attributing the suppletions, (2) examining the differences between the two texts and making any required changes (with attribution), and (3) re-submitting. Thanks for all your hard work!
Entered BL corrections in recto i 26-27, ii 4 and 7; entered corrections suggested in commentary to P.Mich. V 238 in verso lines 13-15, 17, 25

verso I line 13: [ ]υβα̣[ ̣]ι̣ου → [ Θα]υβα̣[ρ]ί̣ου by comparison with the duplicate entry at P.Mich. V 238 ii 88 line 14: [ ]ωνο(ς) → [ Χαιρήμ]ωνο(ς) by comparison with the duplicate entry at P.Mich. V 238 ii 94 line 15: [ ]ο( ) → [ Ὀρσεῦτ]ο(ς) line 17: [ὁμο(λογία) ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣]το( ) → [ὁμο(λογία) Ταμιεῦ]το(ς) by comparison with the duplicate entry at P.Mich. V 238 ii 96 line 25: [ ]ου → [ ὁμο(λογία) Λυσιμάχ]ου by comparison with the duplicate entry at P.Mich. V 238 ii 100. There may have been a day-date further to the left.
